serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: It appears that the integrity of this hall has been compromised. Please watch out for falling elements of the roof and make an appropriate dodge.
#bot.Expression.shock
You: Like hell that’s possible! 
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.sad
You: Sorry {f_botName}, but I must say that this wasn’t a very good date idea…
#bot.Expression.clear
You: I’m glad that you prepared this for me, but I would rather go somewhere safe and have fun. You are welcome to try to prepare a date again, but please choose something more ordinary next time, ok?
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: I will do my best!
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.sad
Bot: Sorry it turned out this way. I thought it would be interesting coming here, but I can see why potentially sustaining an injury at a place like this would qualify as a bad date…
Bot: A person on the internet said it’s completely safe. I should’ve been more distrustful when I found out that it was their last message ever sent.
You: …
#bot.Expression.clear
You: I couldn't agree more.
#bot.Expression.happy
You: Let’s go home then. I will be waiting for your next idea with anticipation! 
#bot.Expression.Veryhappy
Bot: Sure!
